item.description:
Asobi 1.0 (build 2031) Nov 1, 2026

  • A conformed movie, shot by shot. Conform ▸ Shots in a Movie finds the cuts in a client's conform QuickTime, or takes them from a cut file, and lays the movie out as a playlist of its shots. In the timeline a cut movie is one hatched violet band, with the current shot lit.
  • Match Shots to Kitsu. Each shot's middle frame sits beside its Kitsu shot's preview, with a progress bar while it matches. Click a row to jump to that shot and check the match, then Apply to name the shots as in Kitsu.
  • Progress card in the Notes tab. A matched shot shows its percentage, brief and progress notes. Type or dictate a note, pick its day, set the percentage: it goes to the shot's Tracker in Kura Hub.
  • Progress Report (PDF). File ▸ Export ▸ Progress Report: the shots in cut order with pictures, percentages and the latest progress notes, laid out as Kura Hub's report.
  • Movie with Progress Notes. File ▸ Export ▸ Movies: the cut with each shot's name and progress notes burned in as subtitles, across the shot or held on its first frame.
  • Frame.io. Review ▸ Frame.io…: link the movie already on Frame.io (or upload it), post your Asobi notes and each shot's progress at their frames, and bring the client's comments back as notes. Nothing is posted twice. Comments post as Peter King until you Sign In as Yourself, which needs the studio's Frame.io admin to add your Adobe ID first.
  • Notes stay on their frame when shots are cut or joined, and note ticks sit right on trimmed clips.
  • Update Kura Hub to 1.6.55 or later. An older Kura Hub with a Tracker open can overwrite progress notes and percentages Asobi adds, the next time someone edits that shot there.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 2002) Oct 30, 2026

  • Both ACES looks in the View menu. On an ACES 1.3 config, the ACES 2.0 views appear beside ACES 1.0 - SDR Video; on an ACES 2.0 config, the ACES 1.x views appear beside the 2.0 ones. Switching looks is picking the other view, on the same picture and display.
  • Open PDF Manual is always in the manual's sidebar, with the Tutorials or Reviewer Guide PDF under it when that book is open.

1.0 (build 1998) Oct 30, 2026

  • The manual's showcase pictures show the showcase page as it is now, and the conform and sharing chapters use example job names throughout.

1.0 (build 1992) Oct 30, 2026

  • A redesigned review window. A title bar above the picture and one docked control bar below it, so nothing sits on the picture. Every control is an icon over its name; Loop and Speed are pop-ups that read as their value.
  • One Sidebar. Notes, Playlist and Grade are tabs of one panel beside the picture, opened and closed by the bar's Sidebar button. Every window opens with it showing Notes. A tab can pop out into its own window, combine with others in one window, and dock back: useful with a second monitor.
  • A real timeline. Each clip is a named block under the picture, stills wide enough to click, with its notes and one playhead. The film strip can sit in the timeline, be sized by its handle, or have a window of its own.
  • Menus by job. Notes and Conform have menus of their own, Kitsu lives under Review, recording the session is under Notes, and Command-? opens the manual.
  • Drawing tools appear when you draw (P, or the bar's Drawing button), so the picture stays clear the rest of the time.
  • Clearer loop glyphs: Ping-pong is now a single double-headed arrow.
  • The manual is updated throughout, with new figures.

1.0 (build 1966) Oct 29, 2026

  • Who's in a live review: the remote control's window list now says who else is in a window's live review. A window with a shared link up counts as live even when nobody is in the room, and now it says so.

1.0 (build 1963) Oct 29, 2026

  • Kura Hub through Asobi's remote control: an assistant connected to Asobi now reaches Kura Hub too, through the Hub's own tools, while the Hub's remote control is on. Hub commands that post still need the Hub's own Let them post switch.

1.0 (build 1960) Oct 29, 2026

  • Answers at a glance: Review Manager ▸ Presentations now shows a tally once two or more people have answered: how many chose each option, and how many chose it first.
  • A person's choices together: each answer shows the person once, their choices in order (first choice, second choice) with the note on each. When someone sends again, the earlier answer is marked as replaced and only the newest counts.

1.0 (build 1954) Oct 29, 2026

  • Answers you won't miss: when a client chooses on a presentation, a card appears under the title of every review window (who chose what, their note, Open and Dismiss), with a Mac notification and a count on the Dock icon until someone opens it.
  • Everyone named hears about it: the presentation's maker and the project team's studio people get the same card on their own Asobi, an email if nobody has opened it within 15 minutes, and a push on a studio iPhone that has turned it on (Studio settings ▸ Answers to presentations).
  • Assistants: every remote-control action is now also a named command (commands, command help, run), the same way Kento's work, so one assistant drives both apps alike.

Asobi 1.0 (build 2002)

  • Both ACES looks in the View menu. On an ACES 1.3 config, the ACES 2.0 views appear beside ACES 1.0 - SDR Video; on an ACES 2.0 config, the ACES 1.x views appear beside the 2.0 ones. Switching looks is picking the other view, on the same picture and display.
  • Open PDF Manual is always in the manual's sidebar, with the Tutorials or Reviewer Guide PDF under it when that book is open.

Asobi 1.0 (build 1998)

  • The manual's showcase pictures show the showcase page as it is now, and the conform and sharing chapters use example job names throughout.
